name: What factors affect the cost of custom molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of custom molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of custom molding depends on linear footage, the profile complexity, ceiling height, and material choice such as solid wood, paint-grade pine, or medium-density fiberboard (MDF). Labor accounts for a significant portion of the expense because uneven drywall and non-square corners demand hand-scribing, coped corner joints, and extensive nail-hole filling. Multi-piece crown assemblies or rooms with cathedral ceilings take more time and specialized staging than single-piece baseboards. Because HH Remodeling manages both the finish carpentry and final interior painting, combining trim installation with room painting eliminates the expense of hiring separate painting subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom molding costs depend on linear footage, material grade, profile complexity, ceiling height, and whether prep work like drywall repair and painting are included.
